Zaiqa Billing, Zaiqa Waiter and Zaiqa Kitchen apps, version 2.15.4.

Backup & Support now works in the Android app
- Menu > Backup & Support: download a full backup (menu items, deals, categories, tables, waiters, kitchen managers, staff, users, customers, sales, shifts, expenses, inventory and all settings) to the phone's Downloads folder, or share it.
- Restore from file: pick the .json file; the app shows what is inside before replacing everything, and saves a copy of the current data first.
- Automatic daily copy kept inside the app (last 7 days) with one-tap restore.
- Support: call or WhatsApp Innovative Layyah, check for updates and send the error log.
